placeholders.why: The theme's stylesheet and token block: the first thing a re-skin overrides, and the file every customer sheet loads after.
The theme's JavaScript entry point. Ships empty and registered, so adding behaviour is an edit and never a create plus a wiring hunt.
The raw head-injection point. The Swift master's CustomHeadInclude field HTML-encodes, so JSON-LD and meta can only be emitted from here.
The only place a theme can set srcset, fetchpriority and image quality on the page's largest paint. Inert until a paragraph's Template field names it.
Responsive srcset, lazy loading and reserved geometry for a content image. Inert until a paragraph's Template field names it.

The signed-out price affordance. Stock Swift renders an empty div where the price would be when the area's AnonymousUsers field gates prices, so an anonymous shopper sees a blank column with no call to action; this variant renders a neutral lock badge there, and a sign-in anchor on the detail page. Inert until a paragraph's Template field names it, and inert again on any area that does not gate prices.
Overrides the component's hard-coded preload=auto so a page carrying video does not download it on load. Inert until a paragraph's Template field names it.
The wordmark slot, neutral grey. A re-skin overwrites this file in place instead of adding an asset and repointing every field that should have named it.

The boundary motif as a readable single-path source, and deliberately the dullest silhouette available: a barely-perceptible bevel, because a motif with a personality is a brand decision and this layer is brand-free. The CSS utility carries the same path inline as a mask data-URI; this file is what you edit when the silhouette changes.

The worked example of a brand-time motif swap: the Truvio edge, a softened zigzag with gently rounded peaks. Nothing paints it - the theme's --td-edge-mask token points at the neutral edge.svg - until a branded site sets that one token to this path as a data URI, which is the whole of the brand-time edit.
